the SANC approach is fully compatible with the standard method of the regularization of IR divergences in top production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of complex masses for top quarks is the best choice to regularize the infrared singularities.

the use of the complex top mass allows one to calculate the electroweak radiatively corrected cross-sections for the single top production processes with high accuracy and in a fully consistent manner.
the top-leg infrared divergences can be regularized in the complex mass scheme and the results of the two regularization schemes agree within the numerical precision of the calculation.
